source: Python explicit 7-layer Maker input manifest (ml6) for Mathematica SHAARP.ml MF export
notes: 7-layer stacks (air / active-film / anisotropic-interlayer / isotropic-interlayer / isotropic-interlayer-2 / isotropic-interlayer-3 / substrate).
